    1. defer(Supplier)

Schnittstelle Deferrable<X,Y>

Typparameter:
X - the input type
Y - the result type
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Applicable<X,Y>, CheckedProvider<A>, Fun<X,Y>, MemoisingApplicable<X,Y>, MemoisingFun<X,Y>, Operator<A>, Pred<A>, Provider<A>, Receiver<A>
public interface Deferrable<X,Y>

Contract for deferring a computation by supplying its input later. A deferrable maps an input supplier to an executable handle (e.g. Callable).

Implementations must be null‑safe: the supplier must not be null and must not supply null inputs. The returned handle must execute the same computation as the immediate variant and must never return null.

    • defer

      Callable<Y> defer(Supplier<X> supplier)

      Returns an executable that, when called, obtains the input from the given supplier and performs the computation, returning the result.

      Contract: supplier must not be null, and must not supply null inputs. The returned handle must not return null.

      Parameter:
      supplier - the input supplier; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      an executable handle that computes the result
